rules.setup: Close sotto Bollinger inferiore (20,2) e RSI(2) <= 10 sulla stessa seduta
rules.entry: Segnale sulla chiusura; ingresso all'open della seduta successiva
rules.stop: 2 x ATR(14) dal prezzo di ingresso, ATR calcolato alla data del segnale
rules.exit: Chiusura al raggiungimento/superamento della Bollinger centrale; stop ATR; massimo 10 sedute
rules.A: Baseline: entry next open after oversold signal
rules.B: After oversold setup, enter next open once at least 2 of the next 3 closes are above the lower Bollinger band; discard if not confirmed within 3 sessions
rules.C: At oversold signal, require at least 2 of the last 3 closes within 1.5% of the lower band and lower band falling on each of the last 2 transitions
rules.D: 40% initial entry on A signal; add 30% on each of two fresh post-entry lower-band Walking confirmations (2 of 3 closes within 1.5%, lower band falling); fixed initial stop, common exit; unused allocation stays in cash
rules.regime_analysis: At setup date classify each instrument independently: UPTREND if close > SMA200 and SMA200 > SMA200 from 20 sessions earlier; DOWNTREND if close < SMA200 and SMA200 < its 20-session lag; SIDEWAYS otherwise when SMA200 is available; UNKNOWN before 200 bars. This is instrument-trend context, not a common market benchmark.
